description: This file defines the TreeGrain class, which implements a distributed tree structure using Orleans grains. It includes logic for initializing child grains based on a hierarchical ID scheme and a Ping method for recursive asynchronous calls.

classes.name: TreeGrain
classes.description: A distributed grain representing a node in a hierarchical tree structure, capable of spawning child grains and performing recursive ping operations.

methods.name: TreeGrain
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the grain's children based on its primary key and hierarchical level.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Asynchronously pings all child grains and waits for their responses.
